events.name: September 2017 Solar Energetic Particle Event
events.reported_context: Historical solar energetic particle event associated with elevated radiation measurements reported by the Curiosity Radiation Assessment Detector (RAD) during 10-12 September 2017. NASA reported that radiation on the Martian surface more than doubled, the strongest solar-particle event RAD had measured since Curiosity landed in 2012.
